annotation.title_clean: Consultation on the draft guidelines on transparency obligations under the AI Act
annotation.title_en: Consultation on the draft guidelines on transparency obligations under the AI Act
annotation.summary_en: European Commission consultation page (8 May–3 June 2026) seeking feedback on draft guidelines for Article 50 AI Act transparency obligations: informing users of AI interaction, machine-readable marking of synthetic content, and deep fake disclosure. Applicable from 2 August 2026, complemented by a voluntary Code of Practice on AI-generated content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Draft guidelines clarify Article 50 AI Act transparency obligations for providers and deployers
Providers must inform users they are interacting with AI and implement machine-readable marks on generated content
Deployers must disclose deep fakes, AI-generated public-interest publications, and emotion recognition/biometric categorisation
Voluntary Code of Practice on transparency of AI-generated content being finalised in parallel
